name: China Resources and Environment Co.,Ltd.
summary: China Resources and Environment Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the recycling and dismantling of waste electrical and electronic products in China. The company is involved in waste electrical and electronic equipment recycling and dismantling; solid waste disposal business in industrial parks; and sale of usable recyclable resources, including metals, plastics, liquid waste, glass, waste components, and others. It serves modified plastics companies, glass processing companies, recycled metal smelting companies, and hazardous waste treatment companies. The company was founded in 1996 and is based in Beijing, China.
